notesExtended: No .blend saved: build_props.py (the named model to follow) ships script+GLB only; the builder re-runs deterministically from props2.config.json, so the script is the reopenable source.
Labels on the contact sheet are image metadata; no text/lettering exists on any 3D model surface (sign boards blank per spec).
assumptions: All palette colours are design values (monochrome constants, zero images); post-box/kiosk green = spec 2f6b3a enamel; IC booth blue 46617a (90s booths commonly blue-green enamel, design value).

Bounds contract (size ±10% per axis) drives several footprint decisions: the lamp/post-box plinths (0.5), hydrant base (0.29), bin base (0.48) carry the x/z footprint so slim upper bodies still meet the lower bound.

Utility pole: spec gives no crossarm length, so the crossarm is 0.6 m (3 insulators on it) to keep total x within 0.6±10%; transformer core stays 0.6x0.8x0.5 but cooling ribs widen effective depth to 0.56 to meet z >= 0.54.
Bus-stop sign depth is held to 0.10 total (pole Ø0.06, board 0.03, roof cap 0.10); board is blank per no-lettering rule.
Planter total height 0.5 = concrete body 0.35 + rim, with a 0.16 hedge block whose top lands at 0.495 (hedge inside the size envelope).
Bike rack hoops use right-angle corners (3 rods each) to fit the 500-tri budget; rails/legs at z ±0.16 so depth 0.368 meets the 0.36 lower bound.
Kiosk counter recess / window bars / shutter roll / side magazine strips are design inference from the 1990s kiosk type; no lettering anywhere.
Lamp arm curvature approximated with 4 straight rod segments per arm (PLAN fallback: curves <= 8 segments).
Trash bin liner is an open cup (side wall + bottom) so the two-opening centre divider reads from above.
notes: Blender runs: one process per stage, -t 4, sequential (<=1 concurrent, limit 2).
No npm ci / npm install; node libs used from the main repo via absolute path (validator only).
